title: Only change the color of the bullets in the list
goal: Adjusts the list mark via ::marker while retaining the text color.
summary: The registration list needs to retain the original symbols and mark items in dark green. The text still uses the main text color of the page.
tasks: Set the ::marker of the .gear direct list item to #125a46.
retains the list item body color and original bullets.

example.note: ::marker points to a browser-generated number or bullet for a list item.

hint: Select .gear > li and add ::marker at the end.
